Container.Name: kwattson
Container.Overview: Monitor home solar, batteries and electric vehicles. See a two-day battery plan based on your electricity prices. The setup wizard starts in monitoring mode.
Container.Requires: An HTTPS reverse proxy. Enter the address you use to open the dashboard below.

Config.Name: Dashboard HTTPS address
Config.Description: Required. Enter your reverse proxy address, for example https://energy.example.com. Include the port if it is not 443.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Stores settings, credentials, readings and backups. The container runs as user 99 and group 100.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxy IP
Config.Description: Set to the IP of your proxy as seen by the container so login rate limits use each client's IP.

Config.Name: Allowed local services
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated hostnames of local services the app may contact, for example homeassistant.local.
